description: Return the exact Topics to create or reuse, per-search assignments, conflicts, credits and planFingerprint without activating. Use execute_search_activation with that fingerprint to commit. Changes only the requested workspace state. Backend authorization, validation, pricing, balance and idempotency controls remain authoritative; tool selection does not authorize additional work.

allowCreateTopics.description: When topicMode is auto or mixed, whether automatic organisation may propose new Topics. Default true.

command.description: Canonical preview command snapshot. Send this on execute so automatic assignments are not reclassified.

items.description: Batch searches. Each item may include value, region, platform, and topicRefs.

platform.description: Supported tracking platform key, such as instagram, tiktok or youtube; the backend rejects unsupported platforms.

topicDefinitions.description: Existing or inline-create Topic definitions with stable refs. Several searches may share one new Topic ref.

topicMode.description: explicit assigns named Topic refs; auto classifies omitted Topics; mixed keeps explicit rows and classifies the rest. Default auto.

topicRefs.description: Topic refs from topicDefinitions to assign to a single search.

workspaceId.description: Authorized workspace for this requested write; discover accessible context first.

name: socialseal_preview_search_activation
title: Preview Topic-aware search activation
